verdict.rationale: Pylon documents several first-party natural-language interfaces. The Assist Agent can be messaged to investigate issues, draft replies and perform actions. Ask AI is a chat that answers questions about your data, and the Slack Agent takes quick actions from Slack; external AI tools can also read and update issues through the official MCP server. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, an enumerated scope of which actions can be performed via natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Assist Agent is an interactive AI teammate that helps your team investigate questions, draft replies, and take action with the context already available in Pylon.
Ask AI is a general purpose AI chat that can help you and your team answers all the questions you might have about your existing data.
Slack Agent brings Pylon's agentic capabilities into Slack so internal teams can answer product and customer questions and take quick actions without leaving Slack.
